maria: Quick sync — need to align SI onboarding cohort, marketplace listing, and HW voucher handoff. Proposed cohort dates: May 6-8, 2026. Can we lock those?
ajay: May 6-8 works from enablement side. Can we get a pre-read deck by Thursday?
taylor: SEs can run the hands-on lab on day 2. Need GPU access for ~20 folks. Kevin — can Dedicated team carve capacity?
kevin: We can reserve a small Dedicated pool for the 3 days. I'll open a ticket and attach capacity numbers. ETA EOD today.
jen: I can draft the assessment and certification rubric. Quick question — expected deliverables from the SI after training?
maria: Deliverables: 1) Marketplace listing assets + checklist, 2) HW voucher redemption flow + partner SLA, 3) Certification exam (proctored) and a submitted lab artifact.
taylor: Adding hardware partner contact: @natalie_hw — can you confirm voucher distribution cadence and format (single-use codes vs portal)?
natalie_hw: Happy to — prefer single-use codes for auditing but we can support portal-based redemptions if needed. Need final participant list and preferred regions for voucher shipping (us-west / emeast).
maria: We'll split cohort by region: US-W and EMEA. I'll share roster by Friday COB.
ajay: Also need marketing-approved joint announcement copy for the marketplace launch window. @kevin can you loop in comms?
kevin: Looping comms now. I'll push a draft by Monday for review.
marketplace-bot: Listing draft created: https://redwood.example.com/marketplace/drafts/si-ecosystem-1791234567
maria: Thanks — dropping a short checklist: 
- finalize cohort dates
- share roster + timezones
- training deck v1
- cert rubric + pass criteria
- voucher token list and redemption doc
- marketplace draft review and joint-announce copy

taylor: Noted. Lab infra quick commands I'll use for provisioning: 
```bash
# lab setup
rctl allocate --pool dedicated-si --count 5 --gpus a100
rctl grant-access --users @cohort --expire 2026-05-09
```
jen: Quick policy question for product: will the certification be proctored or take-home? My recommendation: proctored for enterprise credibility.
ajay: Agreed — proctored preferred.
maria: Proctored it is. I'll set up a vendor convo next week and share options.
kevin: Ticket RDW-4829 created (reserve Dedicated pool + comms). Link: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/RDW-4829
maria: Perfect — thanks. Next check-in: Friday 10:00am PT. /remind @channel check-in Friday 10:00
